paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.79% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.36%) and Hang Seng weakest (-2.88%). Brent crude changed +0.84% to 109.7. Gold changed -2.85% to 4,024.7. Bitcoin changed -5.16% to 79,678.7969. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.986%, a relative move of -2.92%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+11.18%) and Vale (-8.47%) moved the most.
